Instructions: Single operating checklist from discovery through ongoing SEO. Version 4.4, reviewed and expanded 27 August 2026.
Resolve Phase 0 decisions first, then complete Phases 1–4. Phase 5 is live launch verification, Phase 6 is the first 30 days, and Phase 7 is ongoing maintenance.
P0 = critical impact; P1 = important; P2 = later or optional. Priority no longer decides whether a task blocks launch.
Yes = active and counted. No = excluded from progress. Review = a human must decide whether the condition in Applies to matches this project.
Yes means the task must be Passed before launch only when Applies? is Yes. Conditional gate rows with Applies? = Review keep the launch decision on HOLD until scope is resolved.
Use Not started, In progress, Passed, Failed or Skipped (N/A). An applicable launch gate cannot be bypassed with Skipped; set Applies? = No with rationale if it genuinely does not apply.
Link or describe the exact crawl export, screenshot, test URL, ticket, approval or monitoring result that proves Done when. Evidence should be reproducible by another reviewer.
Optional editable date in yyyy-mm-dd form. Assign dates and owners in the project plan rather than inventing generic deadlines.
Progress counts only Applies? = Yes tasks. GO requires zero applicable gates outstanding, zero failed gates, and zero unresolved applicability decisions for conditional launch gates.
International, migration, facets, pagination, non-HTML, ecommerce, local, analytics/consent, schema and AI rows now appear in their real lifecycle phases rather than a separate final phase.
This workbook prompts scope and evidence decisions; it is not legal advice or compliance certification. Use qualified review for privacy, consent, consumer and accessibility obligations.
